items.title: Greens warn of private school fees loophole in Labor's trust tax
items.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers is preparing to introduce legislation for a 30 per cent tax on discretionary trusts on Wednesday amid fierce business opposition, but has been presented with another obstacle from the Greens.

items.title: Apple Bets on a $299 Siri Screen as Its Home Prices Keep Climbing: Here’s What It Means for AAPL Stock
items.summary: Apple (AAPL:NASDAQ) finally has a screen for the kitchen counter. At its “Welcome home” event in New York on Tuesday, October 13, Apple launched HomeView, a Siri-powered smart display priced at $299 in both tabletop and wall-mounted versions.

items.title: UnitedHealth Group tops estimates, hikes profit outlook as insurer manages high medical costs
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group said it expects 2026 adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share, up from a previous outlook of $19.50 to $20.00 per share.

aus.headline: Chalmers Lines Up Trust Tax
aus.body: Treasurer Jim Chalmers plans to bring in a 30% tax on discretionary trusts.
aus.why: Business groups are fighting it, and the Greens have raised a new hurdle.

us.headline: Apple Unveils $299 HomeView
us.body: Apple launched a Siri-powered smart display in tabletop and wall versions.
us.why: Apple now finally has its own screen for the kitchen bench.

biz.headline: UnitedHealth Lifts Outlook
biz.body: UnitedHealth beat estimates and now sees 2026 adjusted EPS of at least $20.50.
biz.why: It is a read on how US health insurers are handling high medical costs.
